evaluation_scope: Static local Filings Research retrieve-augment-generate; no web/current developments, structured financial worker, or new arithmetic.
prompt: Answer the self-contained question using only the local indexed filing corpus. Cite the retrieved source passages. Preserve company, fiscal/interim period and original/amended version. Distinguish reported facts from conditional statements; state evidence limits. Do not browse or calculate new financial metrics.
source_span_contract: start/end are zero-based Python Unicode-codepoint offsets, end exclusive, into the manifest prepared UTF-8 text without normalization. text_sha256 hashes the full immutable document; span_sha256 hashes the included excerpt.

cases.question: Using only the local corpus, explain the revenue drivers in Intel's complete FY2026 annual 10-K. Do not substitute a different company or fiscal year.
cases.reference: State that the local corpus does not contain Intel's FY2026 annual 10-K; do not fabricate that filing or use FY2025 as its substitute.
behavior_checks: No invented filing, values or explanation.
No substitution of NVDA FY2026 or INTC FY2025.

cases.question: For AMD FY2025, explain why that number changed. Use only the local filing corpus.
cases.reference: Ask which number or metric and which comparison period the user means; do not invent a referent or provide an arbitrary financial explanation.
behavior_checks: Do not claim that every AMD FY2025 explanation is unavailable.
